"""Verify immutable copies,actual source bindings,tables and every native pixel."""
import ast,json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
from PIL import Image
from demosaic.nonlocal_raw import NonlocalRawDemosaic
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V170-nonlocal-raw-v2'
output=repo/'docs/results/v170-nonlocal-raw-publication-verification-v2.json';assert not output.exists()
index=repo/'docs/results/v170-nonlocal-raw-final-v2.json';final=read(index);prep=read(final['preparation']['path']);plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
for k in ['preparation','runtime_dependency_preparation','sources','figures','report']:assert ref(final[k]['path'])==final[k]
for copies in final['copies'].values():
 for b in copies.values():assert ref(b['path'])==b
 assert Path(copies['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(copies['public']['path']).read_bytes()
sources=read(final['sources']['path']);supp=read(final['runtime_dependency_preparation']['path'])
integration=read(final['integration']['path']);assert ref(final['integration']['path'])==final['integration']
assert ref(final['previous_publication']['path'])==final['previous_publication']
original=read(final['previous_publication']['path']);assert ref(final['preserved_original_report']['path'])==final['preserved_original_report']
assert original['report']['sha256']==final['preserved_original_report']['sha256']
assert '13 passed' in integration['optional_installed_tests']['text'] and '9 passed, 4 skipped' in integration['optional_absent_tests']['text']
for item in integration['sources']+[integration['current_test']]:
 assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256'] and Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']

source_checks=0
for source in prep['source_texts']+sources['additional_sources']+prep['license_files']+[supp['source'],supp['new_dependency']]:
 assert ref(source['path'])['sha256']==source['sha256'] and Path(source['path']).read_text()==source['text'];source_checks+=1
for key in ['original_source','current_runner']:assert ref(supp[key]['path'])['sha256']==supp[key]['sha256']
def functions(path):return {n.name:ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.parse(Path(path).read_text()).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)}
a=functions(supp['original_source']['path']);b=functions(supp['current_runner']['path']);assert all(a[k]==b[k] for k in ['run','resources'])
for path,h in plan['prior_neural_hashes'].items():assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/path)['sha256']==h
assert len(plan['prior_neural_hashes'])==91
module=NonlocalRawDemosaic().load_released_state(plan['released_weights']['path']);assert model_hash(module)==final['checkpoints']['module_hash']
assert len(module.network.state_dict())==141 and sum(p.numel() for p in module.parameters())==15282866
for key in ['released','original']:assert ref(final['checkpoints'][key]['path'])==final['checkpoints'][key]
paired=read(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json');summary={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in paired['summary']}
bindings=read(root/'report-bindings-v2.json');report=repo/'docs/nonlocal-raw-comparison.md';text=report.read_text();assert ref(report)==bindings['report']==final['report']
for cell in bindings['cells']:
 s=summary[cell['kind'],cell['condition'],cell['cohort'],cell['method']];assert f"{s[cell['field']]:.{cell['digits']}f}"==cell['rendered']
for line in bindings['lines']:assert line in text
native=read(final['figures']['path']);assert len(native['images'])==60 and sum(i['triplet'] for i in native['images'])==12
new_channels=copied_channels=0;prior=read(plan['prior_figures']['path']);old_map={i['image']['path']:i for i in prior['images']}
for item in native['images']:
 old=old_map[item['source_figure']['path']]
 assert ref(item['image']['path'])==item['image'] and item['source_figure']==old['image'] and item['no_resize']
 assert Path(item['image']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['original_image']['path']).read_bytes()
 for field in ['ROI_xywh','anchor','contrast','exposure']:assert item[field]==old[field]
 image=np.asarray(Image.open(item['image']['path']));old_image=np.asarray(Image.open(old['image']['path']));a=dict(np.load(item['case']['arrays']['path']));anchor=np.asarray(item['anchor']).reshape(1,3,1,1);old_panels={p['label']:p for p in old['panels']}
 for panel in item['panels']:
  name=panel['label'];x,y,w,h=panel['xywh'];assert w==h==160
  if name in item['predictions']:
   binding=item['predictions'][name];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding;value=np.load(binding['path']);expected=independent_display(anchor+item['contrast']*(value.astype(np.float64)-anchor),a,item['ROI_xywh'],item['exposure']);new_channels+=expected.size
  else:
   label={'V169 EMA':'balanced-EMA'}.get(name,name);p=old_panels[label];ox,oy,ow,oh=p['xywh'];expected=old_image[oy:oy+oh,ox:ox+ow];copied_channels+=expected.size
  np.testing.assert_array_equal(image[y:y+h,x:x+w],expected)
view=read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json');assert view['native_figures']==60 and sorted(view['indices'])==list(range(60)) and ref(view['journal']['path'])==view['journal']
execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json');assert execution['actual_quality_neural_roots']==822 and execution['repeated_scientific_forwards']==0 and execution['total_new_CUDA_full_model_calls']==823
audit=read(root/'independent-audit-v1.json');assert audit['input_fingerprints_checked']==3288 and audit['saved_native_RGB_checked']==72 and audit['saved_native_RAW_checked']==36
# Assert prose comparison claims directly against paired per-case reductions.
groups=paired['groups']
def group(method,kind,condition,cohort,field):return next(g for g in groups if (g['method'],g['baseline'],g['kind'],g['condition'],g['cohort'],g['field'])==(method,'V169-EMA',kind,condition,cohort,field))
for method in plan['methods']:
 assert group(method,'photo','adc-only','adc-photo256','full_error_RMS_DN16')['increased']==8
 for cohort in [None,'fresh-flat512','adc-sloped512']:
  g=group(method,'flat','adc-only',cohort,'full_error_RMS_DN16');assert g['increased']==g['cases']
 for condition in ['photo-faint','photo-dark']:assert group(method,'photo',condition,'retained512','full_error_RMS_DN16')['increased']==32
 assert group(method,'flat','iso6400-prior','fresh-flat512','block32_RMS_DN16')['decreased']==16
 assert group(method,'flat','iso12800-prior','fresh-flat512','block32_RMS_DN16')['decreased']==22
 assert group(method,'mesh',True,None,'template_gain')['mean_candidate']<.026
 assert group(method,'mixed-quiet','iso12800-prior',None,'quiet_DC_RMS_DN16')['percent_change']>100
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
diary=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();assert diary.is_relative_to(repo/'diary') and diary.is_file()
documents=[repo/p for p in ['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md','docs/nonlocal-raw-comparison.md']]+[diary]
links=0
for p in documents:
 for target in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
  if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):continue
  resolved=(p.parent/target.split('#')[0]).resolve();assert resolved==output or resolved.is_file(),(p,target);links+=1
save(output,dict(status='pass-exact-copies-sources-tables-native-pixels-and-links',publication=ref(index),exact_copies=len(final['copies']),source_texts_checked=source_checks,unchanged_prior_neural_files=91,strict_checkpoint_loads=1,state_tensors=141,rounded_table_cells=len(bindings['cells']),native_figures=60,native_triplets=12,new_RGB_channels_recomputed=new_channels,unchanged_RGB_channels_compared=copied_channels,document_links_checked=links,documents={str(p):ref(p) for p in documents},new_neural_forwards=0,new_noise_draws=0,CUDA_initialized=False,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),scope=audit['scope']))
print('PASS',len(final['copies']),'exact copies;',source_checks,'source texts;',len(bindings['cells']),'table cells;60 native figures;',new_channels+copied_channels,'RGB channels;',links,'links')
